The project is fully repaired and verified. Summary of the work:

**Repaired modules in `/workspace/submission`** (13 entries, ~41 KB, no links):

| Module | Role |
|---|---|
| `run.py` | JSON stdin→stdout entry point; always exits 0, rejected requests yield `{"error":"invalid_request"}` |
| `formats.py` | Strict envelope validation: exact key sets, integer tokens (no `3.0`/`3e0`), duplicate keys, nonfinite constants, trailing data, bool-as-int, padding-suffix rule, per-class train/validation coverage, all row/op/aggregate budgets, depth ≤ 32, ≤ 64 MiB |
| `offline_discovery/rule_generate.py` | Fragments from exact population mean/σ high positions over the **real prefix**, runs ≥ 2, width-window max-sum with earliest tie; exact `(3/5)^A` anchored distance in integer arithmetic (straddle `+1000` folded into a monotone map), per-class density `max(2,⌈m·ratio⌉)`, cores, connected components, noncore attachment, noise; σ-expanded `[max(0,⌊lo−σ⌋),min(3028,⌊hi+σ⌋)]` boundaries |
| `offline_discovery/rule_remove.py` | Bitset window matching for `hits[c]`, exact rational `Cin/(Cout+1/10000)`, `kept`, priority (score ↓, id ↑); exact-bank distinct-key count (per-length Cartesian products minus 1514) clipped to `capacity.exact+1` |
| `online_matching/train_rf.py` | Pinned `DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=10, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced')`, native-order certificate (`[class]` / `[feature,2t,left,right]`), left iff `2f ≤ 2t` |
| `online_matching/match_p4.py` | One bitset automaton over all pattern lengths; bit index = priority rank, padding row doubles as the "no packet yet" sentinel |
| `sessions.py` | Atomic installs (`ok`/`busy`/`oversize`), eviction of an unreferenced previous bank, pinning by open (incl. classified) epochs, epoch-per-flow counters, direction fixing, idle/segment/limit/close commitment, timestamp monotonicity, final snapshot |
| `pipeline.py` | Orchestration + full catalog/installs/decisions/final certificate |

**Verification**: both public fixtures byte-exact; 82 validation/rejection cases; ~4 400 differential cases against an independently written brute-force reference (noncore attachment, multi-length, exact/range, busy/oversize/eviction, all four commit reasons, multi-epoch flows); 6 500 brute-force exact-key-count checks; full published budget (218 432 ops, 200 000 packets, 8 releases, 2 048 patterns) in ~3 s CPU / 4.7 s wall at 250 MB RSS; executed under the real `public_child` seccomp filter and rlimits. (`check.py` itself cannot spawn its child in this dev sandbox because `setsid` is denied here; the identical execution path was exercised directly.)
